'''Chris Coffee''' was a Florida Star Wars CCG organizer who arranged the first SWCCG Open sanctioned by the [[Players Committee]], held at a gaming convention in Kissimmee, Florida, on 22–24 March 2002.<ref name="rfd119a">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8KvLjZofZcY Broadcast 119 - Radio Free Decipher (15 March, 2002): Chris and MaryGail Coffee on SWCCG Open], Player's Council, YouTube (originally released 15 March 2002). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-8KvLjZofZcY Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 119 transcript]], 09:33–10:35.</ref> He and [[MaryGail Coffee]] described the event on [[Radio Free Decipher]] Broadcast 119 (15 March 2002).

== Star Wars Open, Kissimmee 2002 ==
Coffee said central Florida had a core group of product champions and no Star Wars event of Open status. After MegaCon's dates did not work, he took the event to a Kissimmee gaming convention that had asked him for Decipher representation, and obtained Open status for it.<ref name="rfd119b">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8KvLjZofZcY Broadcast 119 - Radio Free Decipher (15 March, 2002): Chris and MaryGail Coffee on SWCCG Open], Player's Council, YouTube (originally released 15 March 2002). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-8KvLjZofZcY Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 119 transcript]], 09:46.</ref> The Open ran on Saturday 23 March from 10 a.m. Prizes included a set of tournament foils and an uncut Imperial foil sheet from Reflections III, and the winner received a bye at the World Championship.<ref name="rfd119c">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8KvLjZofZcY Broadcast 119 - Radio Free Decipher (15 March, 2002): Chris and MaryGail Coffee on SWCCG Open], Player's Council, YouTube (originally released 15 March 2002). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-8KvLjZofZcY Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 119 transcript]], 13:30–15:50.</ref> Coffee said he had taken a break from the game and returned to playtesting for the Open.<ref name="rfd119d">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8KvLjZofZcY Broadcast 119 - Radio Free Decipher (15 March, 2002): Chris and MaryGail Coffee on SWCCG Open], Player's Council, YouTube (originally released 15 March 2002). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-8KvLjZofZcY Internet Archive]. Transcript: [[Radio Free Decipher/Episode 119 transcript]], 17:12.</ref>
